description: ADTS at a core rate of 22050 Hz with channel configuration 0 and a program config element in every block (a front single channel element and a front channel pair element, three channels), the single channel element followed by SBR data with the parametric stereo extension's ID: as with channel configuration 3, parametric stereo is not applied to a core of three channels, and the ID is reported.
findings: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC,
12 of 12 raw data blocks carry the parametric stereo extension's ID, but the core has 3 channels

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
